description:
£160 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this superb six bedroom student house, ideally situated on the ever-popular Queens Road in the heart of Jesmond.

Perfectly positioned for student living, the property is just a short walk from the shops and cafés on Acorn Road, the popular bars and restaurants on Osborne Road, and West Jesmond Metro Station, providing excellent transport links to both Newcastle University and Northumbria University.

Arranged over three floors, the property offers spacious accommodation throughout, comprising a generous lounge, a well-equipped kitchen, two bathrooms and six generously sized double bedrooms, making it an ideal home for a group of students looking for space and comfort in a fantastic location.

With Jesmond's excellent range of amenities right on your doorstep, this property offers the perfect balance of convenient student living and vibrant surroundings.

Don't miss out on this fantastic student property! Contact My Property Box today and speak to our friendly Lettings Team to arrange your viewing.
